name: django-api-versioning-site
description: Static evidence site for the django-api-versioning Python package.

scripts.dev: npm run sync:articles && npm run sync:evidence && astro dev
scripts.build: npm run sync:articles && npm run sync:evidence && astro build
scripts.build:offline: npm run sync:articles && npm run sync:evidence && astro build
scripts.check: npm run sync:articles && npm run sync:evidence && astro check
scripts.test: npm run sync:articles && npm run sync:evidence && node --test
